Review this bundle with your partner and get the owner's approval of the full plan before writing. First check the same command with --dry-run.

```bash
./install.sh --resolve <file> --from <merged file>
./install.sh --resolve <file>   # Use the current edited file as the result
./install.sh --resolve --keep <file>
./install.sh --resolve ~/.claude/settings.json --from <merged file>
./install.sh --resolve ~/.claude/settings.json
./install.sh --resolve --keep ~/.claude/settings.json
```

./install.sh --rollback undoes the latest resolve first, then the update.
